derived_code: work/deep-hermitage/derive.py (copied below): mean(tmean[3:10]) April to October for Romans and Orange; sum(rr[5:8]) June to August; haversine for distances; sun factor from the atlas sunLUT formula (web/index.html, Apr to Oct, lat 45) for slope 14 deg, aspect 186 and 6, relative to flat.
derive_py:
import json,math
romans=dict(tx=[8.1,9.9,14.7,18.2,22.4,26.6,29.3,29,24,18.7,12.4,8.4],tn=[0.8,0.9,3.5,6.2,10.3,13.7,15.4,15.1,11.7,8.8,4.4,1.5],
 tm=[4.4,5.4,9.1,12.2,16.3,20.2,22.3,22.1,17.9,13.7,8.4,5],rr=[52.3,41.8,51.5,72.9,83.7,66.1,59,68.8,104.4,115.8,106,54.4])
orange=json.load(open('facts/deep-chateauneuf.json'))['monthly']
o_rr=orange['orange_precip_mm']; o_tm=orange['orange_tmean']
def hav(a,b,c,d):
    R=6371;p=math.radians
    x=math.sin(p(c-a)/2)**2+math.cos(p(a))*math.cos(p(c))*math.sin(p(d-b)/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(math.sqrt(x))
R_=math.pi/180
def sun(lat,slope,aspect):
    phi=lat*R_;flat=0;tot=0;s=slope*R_;A0=aspect*R_;n=91
    while n<=304:
        dec=23.44*R_*math.sin(2*math.pi*(284+n)/365);t=4
        while t<=20:
            h=(t-12)*15*R_;sa=math.sin(phi)*math.sin(dec)+math.cos(phi)*math.cos(dec)*math.cos(h)
            if sa>0.02:
                ca=math.sqrt(1-sa*sa);A=math.acos(max(-1,min(1,(math.sin(dec)-sa*math.sin(phi))/(ca*math.cos(phi)))))
                if h>0:A=2*math.pi-A
                I=0.7**((1/sa)**0.678);flat+=I*sa
                c=math.cos(s)*sa+math.sin(s)*ca*math.cos(A-A0)
                if c>0:tot+=I*c
            t+=.25
        n+=7
    return tot/flat
rlat,rlon=45.05,4+59/60+55/3600
d=dict(rain_sum=round(sum(romans['rr']),1),jja_rain=round(sum(romans['rr'][5:8]),1),orange_jja=round(sum(o_rr[5:8]),1),
 son_rain=round(sum(romans['rr'][8:11]),1),son_share=round(100*sum(romans['rr'][8:11])/sum(romans['rr']),1),
 aproct_tmean=round(sum(romans['tm'][3:10])/7,2),aproct_tmean_orange=round(sum(o_tm[3:10])/7,2),
 relief_m=325-119,station_lat=rlat,station_lon=round(rlon,4),km_station_to_centre=round(hav(rlat,rlon,45.07683,4.84662),1),
 km_orange=round(hav(44.14444,4.86083,45.07683,4.84662),0),
 bbox_len_km=round(hav(45.0764,4.83,45.0764,4.8652),2),
 sun_south14=round(sun(45,14,186),4),sun_north14=round(sun(45,14,6),4))
print(json.dumps(d,indent=1))
json.dump(dict(derived=d,romans=romans),open('work/deep-hermitage/derived.json','w'),indent=1)
